title: LOD ladder
description: Declares a module's level-of-detail ladder. The unifying idea of this contract set: every level is placed on ONE objective axis, max_geometric_error_m, regardless of whether it was authored for CAD inspection or for district traversal. A viewer mode does not get its own ladder; it gets an error budget on the shared ladder. That is what lets a CAD-grade bridge and a streamed neighbourhood coexist in one scene without forking the viewer. See VIEWER-MODES.md.

selection.description: How a consumer chooses a level. Both viewers MUST implement screen_space_error selection so that a shared scene resolves consistently; distance bands are a debugging aid only.

default_sse_budget_px.description: Refine a node while its screen-space error exceeds this many pixels.

mode_sse_budget_px.description: Per-viewer-mode override of the error budget. This single object is the entire technical difference between 'inspect the bridge in CAD detail' and 'walk the district efficiently'.

hysteresis.description: Fractional dead-band applied to the budget when a level is already resident, to stop popping while the camera dithers on a threshold.

intent.description: Why the level exists. 'inspect' levels are authored for measurement and part selection. 'traverse' levels are authored to be walked past at speed. A level MAY be reachable in any mode; intent documents authoring purpose, it does not gate access.

max_geometric_error_m.description: Worst-case deviation of this representation from the module's control geometry, in prototype meters. THE shared currency. Monotonically decreasing as level increases is NOT required; consumers sort by this value, not by level index.

triangle_budget.description: Approximate upper bound per tile or per asset at this level. Null when not applicable.

selectable.description: Whether individual assets can be picked at this level. Context and silhouette levels are usually merged geometry and are not individually selectable.

carries_metadata.description: Whether per-asset metadata is delivered with this level. If false, a viewer must fetch metadata separately before it can populate a panel.

streamed.description: True when the level is delivered through the tile index rather than as a single payload.

typical_distance_m.description: Advisory distance band. Debugging and authoring aid only; never normative for selection.
